hypothesis: Infer a global DOS opening template from its first action choice beyond hard public mobility and rank disclosures.
decision: DEFER policy integration, registration and saved strength games: no incremental template/Flag information in this bounded first-action experiment.

primary_research.authors: Chris L. Baker, Rebecca Saxe and Joshua B. Tenenbaum
primary_research.title: Action understanding as inverse planning
primary_research.verified: Primary MIT-hosted21-page PDF accessed with web tool2026-10-16.
primary_research.relationship: The paper uses a forward generative action model and Bayesian inversion to infer hidden agent goals/beliefs from actions. Our proposed extension treats source-defined deployment template as the latent cause and the actual source engine as the forward model. The paper establishes no Stratego-specific benefit.

distinction: Passive source-known action inference needs no sacrificial Scout probe, extra information reward or runtime move-score change. Existing TemplateMixtureBeliefs conditions only on hard origin/rank/mobility facts; this tests whether voluntary origin/destination choices convey additional formation information.

experiment.source: OriginalAI executing pinned1990 resident/overlay5 instructions, level3 Colonel, Classic.
experiment.own_armies: Three pre-existing validated formations plus the previously defined DoubleShellFortress; no new formation fitted here.
experiment.conditioning: DOSBlue acts after the legal first ownRed quiet move. First own move uses only full own ranks and public initial enemy occupancy; no hidden template enters its selection.
experiment.seed_contract: Only fresh private independent16-bit research move seeds are passed to model executions. All were excluded from saved tournament move seeds at configuration time. Never use the actual observed match move seed, shared visible seed or hidden deployment state to reconstruct the opponent.
experiment.truth_contract: Each simulated world is a public source template hypothesis, not an actual referee enemy army. Full own army is legitimate private input. Public event includes origin/destination and any battle or long-Scout rank disclosure.
experiment.classifier: Fixed add-one action-frequency diagnostic, trained only on first4 RNG samples/template within each own-formation context. No parameter search. It is not claimed as a calibrated normalized original-engine Bayesian likelihood.

main_result.replication: Exactly these results for each of the four own formations. Every template/formation produces one identical first action across all8 sampled RNG seeds.

critical_control: Every main first action is a long Scout move or Scout capture, publicly disclosing Scout rank. All source front ranks are mobile, so a MOVED-only comparison would falsely credit inverse planning with information already supplied by that rank disclosure. Once the template model applies the full legal public event, the voluntary origin/destination yields zero additional information in these samples.

orientation_control.context: Separate post-audit mechanical DOSRed first-player context, with both army strings reflected by row to preserve their physical180-degree counterpart. No prior own move is fabricated.
orientation_control.result: Raw plugin MI1.75bits, conditional MI beyond public compatibility mask0bits for all4 formations.
orientation_control.limitation: One seed only; not a heldout predictive test or claim of orientation invariance. Side/turn contexts require separate conditioning.

limits: Only the eight-template foreground was measured, not the procedural20% background; action likelihood might help foreground/background recognition but this experiment does not show that.
No extra information in sampled first decisions does not prove no later behavior can reveal a template.
Eight research RNG values do not establish universal determinism over the DOS seed space.
Finite-sample plugin mutual information can be upward biased. Heldout RNG scoring is separate, and own formations/templates are shared across splits.
Entropy reduction alone would not establish calibration, actionable routes or playing-strength benefit; here even incremental prediction is absent.
No live runtime lookup, policy, model source, shared runner or registered ID was changed.
future_condition: Revisit only if independent public later-action evidence supplies a distinct behavior-dependent formation signature beyond already disclosed ranks. Do not expand samples or fit action bonuses merely to force an opening identification signal.
